channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Briarwood wins three, takes third in Lakeshore Shootout Gold Division
item.description: Briarwood is off to a 3-0 start to the season with victories over Sparkman, Northridge and Albertville to finish third in the Lakeshore Shootout Gold Division.

item.title: Chelsea defends top ranking with three wins in Lakeshore Shootout Gold Division
item.description: No. 1 Chelsea finished the Lakeshore Shootout Gold Division with a 3-0 record, shutting out Northridge, Thompson and Albertville to claim second place.

item.title: Calera wins Lakeshore Shootout Silver Division with 3-0 record
item.description: The Calera Eagles went 3-0 in the Lakeshore Shootout to win the Silver Division, beating Indian Springs, John Carroll and Spain Park to win coach Diogo Oliveira’s first three matches.

item.title: Pelham rallies late to advance to sub-regionals by beating Spain Park
item.description: Pelham overcame a spirited fight from Spain Park to dominate down the stretch and advance to both the area championship and sub-regionals.

item.title: Chelsea starts strong against Helena, books sub-regional trip
item.description: Chelsea dropped 92 points in a wire-to-wire win over Helena to advance to sub-regionals and set up a chance for a second-straight area title.

item.title: Calera advances to sub-regionals after beating Chilton County
item.description: Calera sealed its second-straight trip to the sub-regionals by outpacing Chilton County with big nights from Kora Johnson and Maddie Green.

item.title: Hoover Police on scene of officer-involved shooting in Southlake Estates
item.description: The Hoover Police Department is investigating an officer-involved shooting that occurred in the Southlake Estates neighborhood on Sunday morning.

item.title: Chief Grilldaddy and The Hose Draggers sweep awards at 10th Annual Guinness Chili Cook-Off
item.description: Chili, Guinness and community came together Saturday, Feb. 7, as The Beer Hog hosted the 10th Annual Guinness Chili Cook-Off at Campus 124, marking a milestone year for one of Pelham’s most popular winter events.

item.title: Man killed, officer, suspect injured in shooting in Southlake Estates
item.description: The Hoover Police Department provided an update on a shooting that occurred on Sunday, leaving one dead and an officer and suspect injured.

item.title: Owens House leaders meet with Pelham mayor to strengthen support for children and families
item.description: Leaders from Owens House met with Pelham Mayor Rick Wash on Monday, Feb. 2 as part of ongoing efforts to strengthen partnerships with local governments and ensure continued services for children and families across Shelby County.
